name: Khan Academy
tagline: Educational content and exercise data from Khan Academy's learning platform
description: Khan Academy provides educational content covering math, science, economics, and more. Historically offered unofficial/community APIs and internal endpoints for content and exercises; developers should verify current public API availability, authentication, and terms of use before production integration.

auth.details: Historical public endpoints often required no auth; OAuth was used for user-specific data. Current official public API status is uncertain—verify before use.

use_cases: fetch Khan Academy topic tree structure
look up exercise or video metadata by ID
list topics and subtopics for curriculum mapping
retrieve exercise problem data for learning apps
